description: Define geographic service area and location-based keywords to target for local visibility
facilitation_prompts: What cities or neighborhoods do you serve?|Where do most of your customers come from?|What locations should we optimize for?

description: Identify all services offered and prioritize those with highest demand and profit potential
facilitation_prompts: List all services you offer|Which services are most profitable?|Which services do customers ask about most?

description: Understand ideal customer demographics search behavior and pain points for targeted content
facilitation_prompts: Who is your ideal customer?|What problems are they trying to solve?|How do they search for solutions?

description: Identify what makes business unique compared to competitors for differentiation messaging
facilitation_prompts: What makes you different from competitors?|Why do customers choose you?|What's your secret sauce?

description: Uncover origin story mission and values to weave into content for authentic connection
facilitation_prompts: How did you start this business?|What drives you?|What do you stand for?

description: Identify location-specific keywords customers use to find services in the area
facilitation_prompts: What terms do customers use when searching?|Include location modifiers (city + service)|Analyze search volume and competition

description: Extract actual phrases and questions from customer conversations reviews and inquiries
facilitation_prompts: What questions do customers ask repeatedly?|What language do they use (not industry jargon)?|Review common phrases in testimonials

description: Determine whether searchers want information comparison or to purchase for appropriate content
facilitation_prompts: Are they researching learning comparing or ready to buy?|What content serves each intent stage?|Map content to customer journey

description: Identify topics and keywords competitors rank for that you're missing plus opportunities they're overlooking
facilitation_prompts: What topics do competitors cover?|What are they missing?|Where can you differentiate with better content?

description: Find question-based searches (how what why when where) to create FAQ and blog content
facilitation_prompts: What questions do people ask about your services?|Use Answer The Public and People Also Ask|Create content that directly answers these

description: Identify seasonal service demand local events and trending topics for timely content
facilitation_prompts: What services are seasonal?|Local events you can tie into?|Industry trends to address?

description: Design topic clusters with pillar pages and supporting content for topical authority
facilitation_prompts: What are your 3-5 main service categories?|Create hub pages with supporting subtopic pages|Internal linking strategy

description: Plan location-specific pages for each service area with unique local content
facilitation_prompts: One page per location + service combination|Unique content not duplicate|Local landmarks and area information

description: Structure service pages to tell transformation story while optimizing for target keywords
facilitation_prompts: Problem - Solution - Process - Results - Proof - CTA|Weave keywords naturally into narrative|Include testimonials and examples

description: Generate 12-month editorial calendar of SEO-optimized blog topics that educate and attract
facilitation_prompts: Mix of educational informational and seasonal topics|Target specific long-tail keywords|Align with customer journey stages

description: Create weekly GMB post templates that highlight services offers events and updates
facilitation_prompts: What's New posts for updates|Offer posts for promotions|Event posts for happenings|Product/Service posts for highlights

description: Write service pages that tell customer transformation story while naturally including target keywords
facilitation_prompts: Start with customer pain point|Explain your unique solution approach|Show results and social proof|Clear next steps

description: Craft About Us page that weaves in location keywords brand story and local community involvement
facilitation_prompts: Origin story with local references|Team intro with local ties|Community involvement and partnerships|Location-specific trust signals

description: Transform question keywords into FAQ sections that rank for featured snippets
facilitation_prompts: Answer questions concisely (featured snippet format)|Use question as H2 heading|Provide thorough answers with specifics|Include related questions

description: Create detailed outlines for SEO blog posts targeting specific long-tail keywords
facilitation_prompts: Keyword-optimized title and H1|Strategic H2/H3 subheadings with related keywords|Introduction hooks with keyword|Conclusion with CTA

description: Strategically place customer testimonials with location and service keywords throughout content
facilitation_prompts: Pull quotes that mention service + location|Use schema markup for reviews|Feature on relevant service pages|Include customer location if permitted

description: Develop content ideas that local organizations media and businesses would want to link to
facilitation_prompts: Local guides and resources|Community event coverage|Local expert interviews|Neighborhood spotlights and histories

description: Ensure all technical on-page elements are optimized for target keywords and user experience
facilitation_prompts: Title tag with keyword + location (under 60 chars)|Meta description that sells click (under 160 chars)|H1 matches search intent|Keywords in first paragraph

description: Create strategic internal links between related pages to distribute authority and keep visitors engaged
facilitation_prompts: Link service pages to related blog posts|Link blog posts to relevant service pages|Use descriptive anchor text with keywords|Create hub-and-spoke structure

description: Optimize images with location-based keywords in filenames and alt text for image search visibility
facilitation_prompts: Descriptive file names (keywords-location.jpg)|Alt text with keywords and context|Compress for page speed|Add captions when helpful

description: Add structured data markup to help search engines understand business type location services and reviews
facilitation_prompts: LocalBusiness schema with NAP|Service schema for each offering|Review schema for testimonials|FAQ schema for Q&A sections

description: Ensure business name address phone (NAP) is consistent across website and all online directories
facilitation_prompts: Exact same NAP format everywhere|Include on every page (usually footer)|Match Google My Business listing|Consistency builds trust with Google

description: Structure content for mobile readability with short paragraphs headings and scannable sections
facilitation_prompts: Short paragraphs (2-3 sentences max)|Descriptive subheadings every 200-300 words|Bullet points and lists|White space for breathing room

description: Build Experience Expertise Authoritativeness and Trust signals into content for better rankings
facilitation_prompts: Author bios with credentials|Years in business and local history|Certifications and awards|Case studies and results|Customer testimonials

description: Design content layout and CTAs to turn SEO traffic into leads and customers
facilitation_prompts: Clear CTA above the fold|Multiple conversion paths (call form chat)|Trust signals near CTAs|Remove friction from contact process

description: Establish which keywords to monitor for ranking progress and content performance
facilitation_prompts: Primary keywords per page (1-3 max)|Secondary supporting keywords|Track rankings monthly|Celebrate improvements

description: Define success metrics for each content piece beyond just rankings
facilitation_prompts: Organic traffic to page|Time on page and bounce rate|Conversion rate from traffic|Leads or calls generated|Ranking for target keywords
